coldDefinition: New browser process and fresh context for each engine; OS and server caches are not cleared.
limitations: Chromium, Firefox and WebKit are automated engines; WebKit is not shipping Safari.
JS heap excludes worker, GPU and native memory. Missing memory APIs return null.
The ordinary World route tests on-demand startup, not a million-resident backend.
First animation callback is a scheduling observation, not proof of a presented WebGL frame.

browsers.reason: Launch closed before page creation; MachPort bootstrap_check_in permission denied (1100).
